analysis.reasonEn: Recent 5-day -38.71% plunge followed by extreme oversold RSI. ADX at 31.9 indicates a clear trend, but -DI is dominant over +DI (+13.5 vs -47.7), showing downward pressure. At 7.6% of 52-week low ($28.12), further downside potential exists. Given the 3x leverage nature, volatility is likely to increase, thus maintaining a wait-and-see approach.
